title: Terms Clause: The Share of Covered Bench Work the Coverage Answers For
content:
Where bench work on a claim under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans runs at a service level of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service that targets a shorter turnaround than the coverage's own, the coverage answers for a share of what is left rather than the whole of it.

Where the service level the work runs at targets fewer business days than the coverage's own turnaround target and the coverage offers expedited handling, the coverage answers for 0.9 of what is left. Where that level targets fewer business days than the coverage's own turnaround target and the coverage does not offer expedited handling, the coverage answers for 0.8 of what is left. In any other case the coverage answers for the whole of what is left.

## The coverage's own turnaround target and expedited handling

| Plan | Business days targeted for covered bench work | Expedited handling offered |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 21 | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 14 | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 12 | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 10 | yes |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 7 | yes |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 5 | yes |

## Condition and share

| Service level the work runs at | Expedited handling offered by the coverage | Share of what is left the coverage answers for |
|---|---|---|
| targets fewer business days than the coverage's target | yes | 0.9 |
| targets fewer business days than the coverage's target | no | 0.8 |
| targets the same number of business days or more | either | the whole of it |

## Boundary readings

A plan targeting 14 business days whose work runs at a level targeting 14 business days is not a level targeting fewer, so the coverage answers for the whole of what is left. The same plan whose work runs at a level targeting 13 business days is a level targeting fewer, and since that plan does not offer expedited handling the coverage answers for 0.8 of what is left.
